note: PROPOSED prerequisites between compliance records: 'from' should be completed before 'to'. Each edge is drawn from the wording of the master register itself and is marked validated:false until the compliance head confirms it. Prerequisites are not a single chain; many records can run in parallel. Set an edge's validated to true after review, or delete it, or add new edges here.

edges.basis: IOD sanction comes before the FSI sanction (order in the Sanctioning sheet).
SAN-005 is named "EC Fire NOC": it is obtained for the Environmental Clearance application.
SAN-010 is named "Provisional Water NOC for EC".
SAN-012 is named "Provisional Drainage NOC for EC".
SAN-015 is named "IOD Sanction for E.C. Purpose".
EC-002: the Environmental Clearance must be published in the newspaper once obtained.
Consent to Operate follows Consent to Establish.
EC-003: Consent to Establish must be taken before construction activity starts; plinth checking is construction-stage.
The final Garden NOC is needed before the Occupancy Certificate.
The final Water NOC is needed before the Occupancy Certificate.
The final Drainage NOC is needed before the Occupancy Certificate.
EC-004: Consent to Operate is taken before or at the time of the Occupancy Certificate.
Money can only be withdrawn from the separate 70% account once it exists.
The project web page exists only for a registered project.
Quarterly updates are due only once the project is registered.
Advertisements must carry the registration number, which is issued on registration.
Common areas are handed to the association, so the association must be formed first.
The conveyance is executed in favour of the association (or allottee); the association must exist.
Possession of common areas is handed over after the Occupancy Certificate.
TDR utilisation comes before the TDR-linked premium and ancillary FSI sanction.
Permission to erect a lift comes before the completion notice and licence.
The Principal Employer registration is obtained before contract labour is engaged.
